verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents automation features such as invoice approval flows, automated missing-receipt emails, and scheduled payments, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this finance platform. The evidence pack contains nothing about versioning, reviewing changes to, or rolling back those automations. Invoice audit trails are an adjacent control and do not amount to automation version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
